Wealth Architects Has Increased Its Apple (AAPL) Holding by $1.46 Million as Valuation Declined; As Toronto Dominion Bk Ont (TD) Market Value Declined, Tdam Usa Has Decreased Holding
May 10, 2018 - By Darrin Black
Wealth Architects Llc increased its stake in Apple Inc (AAPL) by 35.46% based on its latest 2017Q4 regulatory filing with the SEC. Wealth Architects Llc bought 8,636 shares as the company’s stock declined 3.81% with the market. The institutional investor held 32,988 shares of the computer manufacturing company at the end of 2017Q4, valued at $5.58 million, up from 24,352 at the end of the previous reported quarter. Wealth Architects Llc who had been investing in Apple Inc for a number of months, seems to be bullish on the $933.68 billion market cap company. The stock increased 1.39% or $2.6 $189.96. About 15.65 million shares traded. Apple Inc. (NASDAQ:AAPL) has risen 19.49% 7.94% the S&P500.
Tdam Usa Inc decreased its stake in Toronto Dominion Bk Ont (TD) by 5.41% based on its latest 2017Q4 regulatory filing with the SEC. Tdam Usa Inc sold 10,191 shares as the company’s stock declined 1.92% with the market. The institutional investor held 178,071 shares of the commercial banks company at the end of 2017Q4, valued at $10.43 million, down from 188,262 at the end of the previous reported quarter. Tdam Usa Inc who had been investing in Toronto Dominion Bk Ont for a number of months, seems to be less bullish one the $107.66B market cap company. The stock increased 1.22% or $0.7 $58.28. About 636,160 shares traded. The Toronto-Dominion Bank (NYSE:TD) has risen 15.54% 3.99% the S&P500.
Tdam Usa Inc, which manages about $16.26 billion and $1.75 billion US Long portfolio, upped its stake in Starbucks Corp (NASDAQ:SBUX) by 94,239 shares to 114,210 shares, valued at $6.56M in 2017Q4, according to the filing. It also increased its holding in Arrow Electrs Inc (NYSE:ARW) by 9,300 shares in the quarter, for a total of 17,821 shares, and has risen its stake in Union Pac Corp (NYSE:UNP).

IBC downgraded the stock to “Sector Performer” rating in Friday, August 26 report. The firm has “Neutral” rating by Credit Suisse given on Monday, September 21. The firm has “Buy” rating by Citigroup given on Wednesday, September 14. The firm earned “Outperform” rating on Friday, August 28 by RBC Capital Markets. TD’s profit will be $2.14B for 12.56 P/E if the $1.16 EPS becomes a reality. After $1.23 actual EPS reported by The Toronto-Dominion Bank for the previous quarter, Wall Street now forecasts -5.69% negative EPS growth.
